# Stellar AI
> AI workspace for building and fixing FiveM and Roblox scripts from plain English.

## What Stellar AI does
- Helps users generate, review and improve FiveM and Roblox code.
- Supports FiveM QBCore, ESX, ox_lib, standalone Lua resources and Roblox Luau systems.
- Can produce organised file plans such as fxmanifest.lua, config.lua, client files, server files and README/setup notes.
- Helps debug existing scripts when users paste code, errors and expected behaviour.
- Works as a browser-based AI workspace with chat history, model selection, voice settings, plan usage and Stripe checkout.

## Product positioning
Stellar AI is built for server owners, roleplay communities, Roblox builders and hobby developers who want a practical AI assistant focused on game-script workflows rather than a generic chat tool.

## Public pricing
Prices are in GBP worldwide.
- Free: £0 forever, daily usage allowance, up to 1,800 output tokens, Stellar Fast/Core access.
- Starter: £8/month or £67/year (save £29 / 30%), standard monthly usage, up to 4,000 output tokens, Stellar Fast/Core access.
- Plus: £20/month or £168/year (save £72 / 30%), higher monthly usage, up to 6,500 output tokens, deeper architecture/debugging and stronger multi-file validation, Stellar Fast/Core/Deep access.
- Pro: £75/month or £630/year (save £270 / 30%), highest monthly usage, up to 10,000 output tokens, Stellar Max access and maximum multi-pass engineering review.
The app presents usage as a simple remaining-allowance meter. Free usage refreshes daily; paid plan usage refreshes each billing cycle.
- Server Pass pilot: £50/month for one verified Discord guild. Free Discord /debug includes 2 repairs per day; an activated Server Pass guild bypasses that free daily counter. Provider capacity, input-size limits, safety controls and abuse protection still apply.

## Model tiers
Stellar uses public tier names so backend providers can change without exposing internal routing details.
- Stellar Fast: fast everyday tier.
- Stellar Core: default balanced tier.
- Stellar Deep: deeper advanced tier.
- Stellar Max: highest tier, available on Pro/private access.

## Trust and safety notes
- Generated code should be reviewed and tested before production use.
- The app should not claim unsupported benefits such as priority queues unless backend enforcement exists.
- Billing and cancellation are handled through Stripe where available, with support fallback at support@trystellarai.com.
- Do not claim zero code retention, model training exclusions, unlimited usage, or automatic AST validation unless the deployed product and privacy terms explicitly support that claim.
- Public guides should be helpful, practical and people-first rather than low-value keyword spam.
